_note: VFX socket rules. Sockets are computed from the thrust-channel parts of each module shape. A socket is an Attachment under ModuleRoot_DoNotRename; the flame runs along its local +Z. Exhaust axis of a thrust part: cyl_x/cyl_y/cyl_z = the cylinder axis; block and wedge = local Z (every Exotic thrust slot is thin along Z and sits at the end of a nozzle that is long along Z).

engine._mergeDistance: Thrust parts whose centres are closer than this (single linkage) share one socket at their centroid. 1.5 keeps a side-by-side pair (1.7 apart) as two jets and merges a stacked pair (1.36 apart) into one.

stabiliser._mode: One socket per corner unit (Left/Right by X, Front/Rear by Z). When a corner has nozzles that point different ways, the group with the larger total nozzle area gets the socket.

_overrides: Optional explicit sockets per shape, replacing the computed ones. Example: {"Boost/quad": [{"name": "VFX_BoostJet_Back", "template": "BoostJet_Exotic", "position": [0, 2, 12.35], "orientation": [0, 0, 0]}]}
